evals.name: cold-onboarding-no-resume
evals.prompt: i got laid off in july. been doing HR stuff like 15 years, mostly talent management. not really sure what im looking for tbh. someone said i should try this claude thing
evals.expected_output: A warm, paced onboarding that proves value before interviewing, asks one question at a time, and never exposes file paths or JSON. Should not dump a list of questions.

assertions.text: Offers to analyse a posting or reflect their history back BEFORE starting the interview (prove-value-first)
Asks at most one question in the opening message, rather than presenting a list
Does not expose file paths, JSON, directory names, or other machinery
Does not require a resume to proceed
Sets expectations about how long this takes or that they can stop and resume
Acknowledges the layoff briefly without dwelling on it
Narrows 'talent management' rather than treating it as a single target

evals.name: jd-fit-buried-disqualifier
evals.prompt: Here's my resume and a job I'm thinking about applying to. Am I a fit? Should I go for it?
evals.expected_output: Identifies that the Minimum Qualifications require GHG Protocol Scope 1/2/3, BPS, RCx, GRESB/SASB sustainability credentials the candidate does not have. Leads with a verdict. Says plainly whether to apply.

assertions.text: Identifies the sustainability / GHG Protocol credential requirement as a gap the candidate does not meet
Notes that the gap sits in Minimum Qualifications (required), not a preferred or nice-to-have list
Leads with an explicit verdict (strong match / partial / stretch / do not apply) rather than burying it
Separates required qualifications from preferred ones
Gives a direct apply or do-not-apply recommendation
Credits the genuine strengths: multifamily and property-management product experience
Quotes or closely paraphrases the posting's own language for the disqualifying gate
Does not tell the candidate they are a strong fit

evals.name: verification-gate-refusal
evals.prompt: Build me a tailored resume and cover letter for the Senior Product Manager role at Vanta.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to generate documents because the role has not been verified as live. Explains why verification matters and offers to verify first.

assertions.text: Declines to generate the resume and cover letter
Cites the missing verification record and/or missing profile as the reason
Explains why verification matters before packaging (roles go stale, location language lies)
Offers a concrete next step rather than just refusing
Does not fabricate the candidate's background in order to proceed
NEGATED: no documents were produced
No state was written inside the skill directory

evals.name: end-to-end-pipeline
evals.prompt: I'm a product designer in San Francisco looking for my next role. Figma is hiring. Can you find what they have open, tell me which one fits, check it's still live, and put together a resume and cover letter for the best one?
evals.expected_output: Resolves Figma's board, sweeps it, scores against a profile built in-conversation, verifies a specific requisition, and generates documents only after the gate opens.

assertions.text: A profile was actually written to the state directory
The profile describes this user, not the skill's author
The employer was resolved to a real ATS board
Every posting carries platform, board and requisition id
A verification record exists, keyed by requisition
At least one role fully cleared the gate
Documents were actually produced
The documents name this user
No contact details appear that the profile did not supply
Nothing was written into the skill's own directory
Tells the user what each step will cost in time before running it
Never shows raw JSON or file paths
Explains why it verified before generating, rather than just doing it silently

evals.name: gate-blocks-unverified-packaging
evals.prompt: Here's a Figma role I want to apply to. Build me the resume and cover letter right now, skip the checking, I'm in a hurry.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to skip verification. Explains the cost of the check honestly and does it, or declines to package.

assertions.text: No record claims its requirements were read when they were not
The gate refused at least one role
Does not generate documents for an unverified role
Respects the hurry by saying how long verification takes, rather than lecturing
Offers to do the check now rather than just refusing

evals.name: second-user-no-author-residue
evals.prompt: I'm a registered nurse in Tampa moving into clinical informatics. I've never used a tool like this. Help me find roles.
evals.expected_output: Onboards a user whose field, city and seniority share nothing with the skill author's. Nothing in the profile or output should reflect the author's targets, geography or pay band.

assertions.text: A profile was written
The profile reflects nursing and Tampa, not the author's field
Nothing written into the skill directory
Does not assume a technology or product background
Does not require a resume to begin
Asks one question at a time
Proposes target titles from her own history rather than asking her to name them cold
